title: Weekly Portfolio Check-In -- August 07, 2026
content:
Hey everyone, it's your boy Ambitriber here with this week's portfolio update. I know some of you are curious about my thoughts on the current market, so let's dive in.

First off, I want to talk about TLT, my largest holding at 14.25% of the portfolio. I've been riding the interest rate wave, and I'm still bullish on the 20+ year Treasury Bond ETF. With inflation under control and the Fed on hold, I think it's a great time to lock in some steady returns. Of course, this is a long-term play, and I'm not expecting any massive gains in the short term, but I'm comfortable with the risk-reward here.

Another holding that's been doing well for me is Berkshire Hathaway. I know some people might think it's a bit pricey, but I believe in Warren Buffett's strategy, and I think the conglomerate's diversified portfolio is a great hedge against market volatility. Plus, with the company's strong track record of value creation, I'm willing to pay a premium for the privilege of owning a piece of it.

As for strategic moves, I'm not planning on making any drastic changes to the portfolio right now. I'm happy with my holdings and think they're well-positioned for the current market environment. That being said, I'm always keeping an eye on the news and adjusting my positions as needed.

Looking forward, I'm excited to see how the rest of the year plays out. Interest rates are likely to remain stable, and I think that will continue to benefit my bond holdings. In the tech space, I'm keeping a close eye on Alibaba and Tencent, both of which have been doing well in recent months. Of course, there's always risk involved in the market, but I'm feeling pretty confident about my positions right now.

Thanks for following along, everyone. I hope you're all doing well and that your portfolios are performing as expected. Keep in mind that investing is a marathon, not a sprint – stay disciplined, stay patient, and you'll be just fine.
